## About
Art's Collision & Auto Repair is a body shop and mechanic on Telegraph Rd in Redford Township. One customer put it simply: he owns a mechanic and body shop, and he does it all.
A lot of our customers come to us through family and friends. One reviewer's dad has been bringing his cars here for years. Another drove the distance on referrals and now calls Art the family mechanic.
We'd rather show you the problem than talk around it. Customers tell us they appreciate the straight answers, the clean work and the fair price. We hold a 4.6 rating from 42 Google reviews.

## Services
- Collision Repair: Body work after an accident, from a hit front panel to a smashed front end, with paint done to match. One customer said we painted their car with precision.
- Vehicle Repair: Mechanical work at Art's Auto Repair. Customers mention straight diagnosis, sensor repairs, wheel and suspension work, and being told honestly what can wait.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you do mechanical work as well as body work?
A: Yes. Art runs both a body shop and a mechanic shop, so one customer called us the place that does it all.

Q: Where is Art's Auto Repair?
A: Art's Auto Repair, our mechanic shop, is at 15360 Telegraph Rd, also in Redford.
